descriptions: Built a text-based scraper and classification pipeline to generate trading signals from broker reports.
Integrated Jev text classification into the trading system for signal generation, with user-reported 99% accuracy and sub-0.5-second latency.
Applied machine-learning meta-labeling to generated signals and developed an ML-based long/short strategy.
Maintained trading infrastructure on Microsoft Azure with Celery and Redis; deployed an MLX-optimized local model on a Mac mini using Ollama.
Constructed and validated BTC/USDT alpha signals with LightGBM; built a 10-factor library from 1-minute order-book snapshots, using correlation filtering to reduce redundancy.
Prototyped a LangGraph alpha-ideation pipeline, reducing research iteration cycles by 60%.
Built a LangGraph smart-contract audit framework that cut audit time from 2 days to 15 minutes, saving over 95% in labor costs while maintaining 93.66% accuracy.
Fine-tuned 7B-72B LLMs with SFT and RLVR (GRPO/PPO) on multi-GPU DeepSpeed clusters; reduced inference latency by 12% and serving costs by 50%.
Built a LangGraph/Qwen3-Next text-to-SQL agent for PostgreSQL, cutting retrieval from 12 hours to under 10 seconds with 95% accuracy.
Built a Ray/Llama 3.1 pipeline extracting revenue and earnings signals from 100,000+ reports with 83% accuracy.
Built a 500,000+ entity financial knowledge graph with PageRank and Louvain clustering, accelerating quantitative signal generation by 52%.
Built a React.js/Flask application with the OpenAI API to automate funding-proposal creation, reducing generation time by 65%.
Built zero-shot QA entity extraction for lending reports with Hugging Face Transformers, achieving 94% accuracy.
Architected, maintained, and supported complex system and network infrastructures.
Administered operating systems, managed server configurations, and oversaw Oracle database server operations.
